📜 Credits & Licenses

Kro

Created and directed by Bran. All characters, places and names are original. Any resemblance to real businesses is unintended.

Made with AI

Kro was made with the help of AI tools, directed, chosen and edited by Bran: the artwork (intro storybook panels, 3D logo, in-game 3D models, textures and UI), the game code, the story and dialogue, and the sound and music code. The How to Play pictures are screenshots captured from the game.

Sound & music

All sound effects and music are synthesized live in your browser by the game's own (AI-assisted) code. No recorded samples.

Open-source software

three.js r160 (3D engine and add-ons: BufferGeometryUtils, EffectComposer, RenderPass, ShaderPass, UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass, CopyShader, LuminosityHighPassShader, OutputShader, GLTFLoader, DRACOLoader). MIT License.

Draco 3D geometry decompression library (Google), used to load Kro's 3D model. Apache License 2.0.

Fonts & emoji

Text and emoji use your device's own system fonts; none are bundled.

Your data

Kro has no accounts, ads or tracking. Your progress is saved only on this device (Settings → Display → Export save to back it up).

    Story

    LEVEL UP!
    LV 2
    AIRSTREAM!
    🌬AIRSTREAM

    Rotate your phone

    Kro plays in landscape. Turn your phone sideways to keep flying — the game is paused.

    You are Kro — totally a crow. Rule the plaza parking lot, skim through fries to reload and boost, and snatch shiny trinkets.

    Bomb pedestrians (+100). Splat a glowing phone (+1000). 3 phones = Mega Scatter-Bomb.

    Roam the whole town — neighborhood, park, gas station and drive-thru fry hotspot. Follow the yellow arrow for quests from your rooftop nest.

    Ride high airstreams (40m+), hold SOAR from 15m up, or bust a 🍟 Raccoon heist. GUST (G) tips bins, shakes trees and knocks out bots. Splash in 💧 bird baths to heal ♥; face the pond goose & 🎨 Rattlecan Rudy.

    Touch: left thumb steers & flicks to barrel roll · buttons Flap / Dive / Brake / Soar / Gust / Drop · ⚙ settings
    Keys: WASD/Arrows steer · Space flap · Shift dive · Q brake · E soar · F/Enter drop · G gust · V camera · Z/C roll · Esc menu
